searchText: Could anyone from blobscan, or anyone that knows anyone from blobscan dm me please? Hey any update? ```2023-04-27 10:04:47.5025|Error when handling ID 1, engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV1({ "finalizedBlockHash": "0xa078e5baf9ed132c3a0cdf998527575359fa3ae3ebe69666c925eb832c456e19", "headBlockHash": "0x46cf45c8adab673f1fc9122894d6e8adb4b92806c98c0f3206bbb9aa2b57d4e5", "safeBlockHash": "0xe425707de6c389ef16ec90181bcf301c41dc0a3409bfd31ee9781bc45b09b003" },{ "prevRandao": "0xc7909fc8e975b821db97b32cd85d292925efedb2d2677ea64f1a28d10c592445", "suggestedFeeRecipient": "0xf97e180c050e5ab072211ad2c213eb5aee4df134", "timestamp": "0x644a48c0", "withdrawals": [] }) | {"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32602,"message":"PayloadAttributesV1 expected"},"id":1}``` Still seeing the same issue with LH nethermind. and its just unable to sync at all. even tho LH seems to be able to optimistically sync up to head On my list, right after block producer fix, hope to have time to check today Looks like we have sync problem because of that (engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV1). Or do expect ELs to allow such case? engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV1 has "withdrawals": [] when not expected shouldn't the EL be backwards compatible? I'd say it's more like forward compatibility, and it's not covered by the spec. I mean engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV1 should be able to receive withdrawals and ignore it, you mean, right? Looks like the latest nethermind build managed to sync up to head with LH ~~Good, let me find out why~~ Yep looks much better yup It's unexpected we would send that field on the `engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV1` endpoint so I will look into that. How LH works is we check `engine_exchangeCapabilities` for the latest version of all endpoint sand always call that versions. Does nethermind expose all the latest versions of the endpoints on exchange capabiliies ? I saw some errors related to engine_exchangeCapabilities in a previous run with an old image, probably fixed So can be not a problem anymore <@792822129019584562> getting while trying to make a proposal: ``` Apr-27 14:57:48.043[] [31merror[39m: Error proposing block slot=8689, validator=0x913a…8038 Failed to produce block: validator.produceBlockV2 - Internal Server Error: Missing blobsBundle response from getPayload at fork=deneb - Failed to produce block Error: Failed to produce block: validator.produceBlockV2 - Internal Server Error: Missing blobsBundle response from getPayload at fork=deneb - Failed to produce block at Function.assert (file:///usr/app/packages/api/src/utils/client/httpClient.ts:44:13) at BlockProposingService.produceBlock (file:///usr/app/packages/validator/src/services/block.ts:351:18) at processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:95:5) at BlockProposingService.produceBlockWrapper (file:///usr/app/packages/validator/src/services/block.ts:220:19) at BlockProposingService.createAndPublishBlock (file:///usr/app/packages/validator/src/services/block.ts:111:29) at async Promise.all (index 0) ``` Does it mean getPayloads blobsBundle is broken? yes no blobs bundle found in response in getpayloadv3 Just finished setting up all the tooling for devnet-5. Everything but blobscan is working. Let me me know if something seems to be broken. Does anyone know of some slot IDs on devnet 5 containing blobs?
